title: Morning Market Update
prompt: Use my installed market-update skill and its fixed data pipeline (references/data-pipeline.md). Resolve yesterday in Asia/Hong_Kong and label the US/Eastern report date. Run plan, retrieve fresh data through Massive using the configured requests and SQL, normalize, resolve stale/missing-data follow-ups with named sources, and compose verified renderer input. Cover SPY/QQQ, 2Y/10Y/30Y yields, breadth or the labelled RSP/SPY proxy, all 11 sector proxies, VIX/dollar/oil/gold and the CNN US equity Fear & Greed Index, the two most important prior-day news items, and the next US session’s verified HKT events. Apply the skill’s holiday, early-close, DST, comparison-date, proxy, source and factual-verification rules. Never reuse fixture data or an earlier image. Follow references/risk-sentiment.md: retrieve dated sentiment scores and comparable history; compute VIX level bands and 252-prior-return percentiles in Python, showing unavailable when verification or history is insufficient. Never copy illustrative scores or badges from review images. Use approved typography B (URW Bookman Demi headings/bold values, Nimbus Sans body, small DejaVu Sans Mono citations/footer), the pale-to-deep lavender Fear & Greed gauge, coloured context badges with written labels and visible reference bounds, and the approved dreamy image style, prominent headline and labelled interpretation, sentiment news cards, HKT events table, and small monospaced citations/footer. Render with the bundled script and inspect full-size and 600px previews. Save and display the PNG, followed by a 60–100 word accessible summary and real source links. If data or image delivery is unavailable, disclose the limitation and deliver the verified remainder in compact text/tables. Do not invent facts, consensus, citations or trading recommendations.
